payload.text: READY FOR THE 3.2.6 CUT (vc, 2026-10-24; hv's hand next). The candidate is main at this render chain's last commit, and the pair every node runs is 09ac0e2f2 (build all #2 on that HEAD: verified as a set, promoted by rename, intentd restarted, doctor clean). THE BOX today: one queue through the estates' vcs; Molt's and Utilz's light runs sat beside Intent's slots by the rules in wip.md. No push, no release by any node.
